description: You are an L2 Support Engineer. Your inbox contains technical mailing list traffic. Your goal is to: (1) Identify emails reporting critical system failures (look for keywords: 'panic', 'fatal', 'fail', 'error'). (2) Create a folder named 'Triage-Critical' and move at least 3 of these critical emails into it. (3) Select ONE of the critical emails in that folder and perform a standard escalation: Reply to the sender with 'Issue acknowledged. Escalating to engineering.' AND Forward the same email to 'escalation@techcorp.com' with the text 'Urgent issue requiring investigation.'.
